shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP: live see-below view, choosable basements, full vanilla parity in work/haul/combat — plus paintable glass skylight zones (stackable, grow-light sun), mountain-top rivers with waterfalls, island-aware logistics, vanilla-exact formation goto, cross-level everything, CE support, elevators, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection OR compile-ref. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message on trip. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB.
- See-below VISION extends through skylight glass; a pane is a WINDOW (flood-unfogs the room below). Orders through glass = orders through air.
- Selection survives column-internal view switches. Mountain rivers MOVE, not duplicate.
- **Pocket maps have no real celestial/climate data — ANY sun/weather/temperature read for a pocket level must resolve through the column's GROUND map** (ClimatePatches for temperature; skylight shafts for sun as of 2026-07-24).
- All levels are real maps. Viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir (Impassable) + AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop (Standable) + AB_Skylight (Standable glass, dontRender).

## LIVE TEST ROUND 3 FINDINGS (2026-07-24) — in progress
1. **Skylight shafts never lit (FIXED)**: ShouldBeLitNow asked `CurCelestialSunGlow(Map)` on the LIT map — the basement, a pocket map with no celestial data — so the 0.4 sun threshold never passed and panes never lit the level below. Now reads the column's ground map (locked decision above). PO cache keying consistent (keyed on the map we pass).
2. **"Basement light sources do not function"** — unconfirmed root cause (no exceptions in bridge; lamps' glow is plain map data). Candidates: unpowered lamps, glow-grid vs overlay regen, or a below-lighting-band interaction. INSTRUMENTED, not guessed: new dev tool.
3. **"Rivers still duplicate"** — round-3 session ran the reworked genstep on a fresh column yet the user reports the tunnel stretch still wet. No genstep exception logged. INSTRUMENTED: `GenStep_ABSkyRivers.LastSummary` static records every run's outcome INCLUDING bail reasons ("no linked ground map" / "no flow data" / "no river cells under sky mass") — inspectable in-session.
4. **RMB blueprint trace still not received** — the user hasn't run "AB: RMB diagnostic" yet; renewed ask.
5. Waterfall Material fields warning — fixed ([StaticConstructorOnStartup] on Thing_ABWaterfall). "AB: below-view diagnostic" palette pin path failed to resolve (cosmetic; dropped from pins).

## DEV DIAGNOSTIC SUITE (all print ONE Log.Warning that crosses the bridge + an in-game confirmation message)
- **AB: RMB diagnostic** (ToolMap): full redirect decision trace for current selection vs clicked cell (maps, drafted, guard+setting, resolved target, stairs, option labels).
- **AB: river diagnostic**: genstep LastSummary + LIVE recount (ground river cells, still-wet-under-mass count — should be 0 after the fix — sky water cells, lips, bases).
- **AB: light diagnostic** (ToolMap): cell's glow value, roofed/fogged, sun on ground map vs this map, every glower at the cell (lit state, power state), shaft gate chain (feature/shouldBeLit/chainOpen), pane-above flag.
- AB: below-view diagnostic (existing), AB: ensure sky + basement (existing).

## RMB 1:1 PARITY BATCH — built (ReplayFresh, column-wide selection, hop-chain, glass clicks, stairs option, selection preservation). VERIFICATION PENDING (trace outstanding).
## DIRECT-TO-BLUEPRINT HAULING — built. BELOW-LEVEL LIGHTING — built. ANIMAL FLOW FIX — built. BAM COMPAT — built. PERF PASS + PERF-MOD AUDIT — complete.
## MOUNTAIN RIVERS — reworked (supersede + banks + rim reveal) + instrumented; round-3 verification contradicts expectations, diagnosis pending the diagnostic run.
## BATCH D skylights — fog-reveal built; shaft sun fix built. BATCH A user-verified; B/C pending.
## SETTINGS — seven tabs (+skylights, mountainRivers, skyVisitorArrivals, hospitalityRoaming, belowLighting).

## Test plan (RELAUNCH round 4, isolated)
1. Fresh column ("AB: ensure sky + basement") on the quicktest map.
2. **AB: river diagnostic** (one click, no setup) -> summary tells carved/dried or the bail reason.
3. **AB: light diagnostic** clicks: (a) a powered basement lamp cell; (b) a basement cell under an installed surface pane (daytime).
4. **AB: RMB diagnostic**: selection held on the sky pawn, click the surface blueprint cell.
5. Visual re-checks: pane lights the room below in daytime (shaft fix); selection persists across view switch; stairs right-click option.
Then the standing stack (animal flow, BAM, Batch B/C, perf-mod smoke, publishing prep).

## Compat
(unchanged) + Better Architect Menu. Perf mods audited. INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## Status
2026-07-24 (13th pass): **shaft sun-gate pocket-map fix built; full diagnostic suite added (river/light/RMB) — every open bug now has a one-click ground-truth tool**. Awaiting relaunch for round 4 evidence collection.
